author: lgrawet
message: fix(backpack_perp): restore snapshot_bal term in balance reconciliation Backpack's `netEquityAvailable` is the free collateral: it already nets out the margin of open positions AND open orders (confirmed empirically and via Backpack's `MarginAccountSummary` schema where `netExposureFutures` is "Total exposure of positions as well potential open positions"). The previous fix dropped the `+snapshot_bal` term, reasoning that the snapshot refresh in `_update_balances()` made it redundant. That reasoning was wrong: `available_balance` (from REST) already has the snapshot-time orders margin subtracted, so subtracting `in_flight_margin` (which includes those same snapshot orders) double-counts. The result is actual = (TE - PM - OM_snapshot) - OM_current + fills_margin ~ TE - PM - 2*OM (when snapshot is fresh) This goes negative whenever the leveraged open-orders margin exceeds the true free collateral, triggering bursts of "Not enough budget" errors even though no real budget shortfall exists. Observed in production: a 22-second burst of 24 errors (1 per tick) at 20:43:58, ending only when `executor_refresh_time` canceled two stale BUYs and freed their margin. Restore the `+snapshot_margin` term using the margin-overridden `in_flight_asset_balances`, and divide `fills_full_notional` by leverage to keep everything in margin units: actual = available_balance + snapshot_margin # cancel what REST already netted out - in_flight_margin # subtract all current in-flight orders + fills_full_notional / lev # add back fills' margin (still locked) Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.7 <noreply@anthropic.com>

author: ch99q
message: fix: dynamic-pairlist backtesting replays stale candles on re-entry time_pair_generator tracks each pair's position with indexes[pair], advanced only while the pair is processed. With a dynamic pairlist a pair can leave the whitelist and re-enter later, leaving its index stale so it replays the candles it missed. A coin that joins the universe mid-backtest then trades its earlier history (lookahead). Skip rows older than the last closed candle on re-entry. Static backtests are unchanged.

Add heartbeat mechanism to WebSocket connection management - Implemented a heartbeat mechanism in the ConnectionManager class to maintain active WebSocket connections and handle ping/pong responses. - Introduced a new asynchronous task for sending ping messages at regular intervals to ensure connection stability. - Enhanced the websocket_endpoint to process pong responses, improving the robustness of the WebSocket communication. - Updated error handling during heartbeat operations to provide clearer feedback on potential issues, ensuring better monitoring of connection health. Improve WebSocket connection management and Redis listener resilience - Updated the ConnectionManager class to enhance the disconnect method by using discard to prevent KeyErrors. - Improved the broadcast method to handle per-connection send failures gracefully, allowing the Redis listener to continue operating even if some clients fail. - Refactored the _redis_listener method to implement exponential backoff for resubscribing on failures, ensuring a more robust connection to the Redis service. - Enhanced error handling during Redis unsubscription to provide clearer feedback on potential issues. Refactor Redis listener in WebSocket manager for improved performance - Removed unnecessary reconnect logic and simplified the Redis subscription process in the ConnectionManager class. - Enhanced the _redis_listener method to directly handle messages from the Redis subscriber, improving clarity and efficiency. - Updated error handling to provide clearer feedback during Redis listener errors, ensuring better monitoring of connection issues. Remove debug logging from Monte Carlo request handling - Eliminated the debug logging section that captured the request body in the `monte_carlo` function to streamline the code and enhance performance. - Maintained existing validation and authorization checks to ensure functionality remains intact. Enhance error logging in Monte Carlo simulations - Improved error handling in the MonteCarloRunner class by including the error type in the log messages for better clarity during simulation failures. - Updated the _safe_log_message function to format error messages distinctly, making it easier to identify issues in the progress bar output. - Refactored error handling in the Monte Carlo candles and trades scenarios to provide detailed error information, including full tracebacks for debugging purposes. - Ensured consistent logging practices across different components of the Monte Carlo simulations to facilitate easier monitoring and troubleshooting. Enhance Redis and WebSocket services, update HTML templates - Added an asynchronous publish function to the Redis service for improved message handling. - Updated the WebSocket manager to include a method for stopping the Redis listener when no active connections exist. - Modified the 200, 404, and index HTML templates to include new NuxtJS configuration scripts for better application performance. - Introduced several new JavaScript files in the NuxtJS static directory to support enhanced functionality and UI components. - Removed outdated CSS entry files and replaced them with updated versions to streamline styling and improve maintainability. improve redis Refactor Monte Carlo metrics handling for clarity and accuracy - Updated the MonteCarloRunner class to improve the handling of metrics, ensuring that original values and percentiles are set to None when not available. - Enhanced the logic for displaying metrics, particularly for max_drawdown, to correctly reflect the worst and best percentiles. - Added comments to clarify the order of metrics displayed and the rationale behind the adjustments made to the max_drawdown calculations. Enhance Monte Carlo session data handling - Added a utility function to convert NumPy types to native Python types for JSON serialization, ensuring compatibility when storing results. - Updated the `update_trades_session_progress` and `update_candles_session_progress` methods to utilize the new conversion function before JSON serialization of results. - Introduced a new configuration parameter `warm_up_candles` in the `MonteCarloRunner` class to allow customization of warm-up candle settings. Enhance error handling and logging in Monte Carlo simulations - Added detailed error traceback logging during Monte Carlo simulation execution to improve debugging capabilities. - Implemented publishing of exceptions to the frontend for better user feedback on simulation errors. - Refactored configuration preparation to flatten the structure from user settings, ensuring clarity and ease of access to configuration parameters. - Enhanced exception handling in both trades and candles simulation methods, ensuring that errors are stored in the database and logged appropriately. Add Monte Carlo simulation functionality - Introduced a new controller for Monte Carlo simulations, including endpoints for starting, canceling, terminating, resuming, and retrieving session details. - Implemented the MonteCarloSession model to manage session data in the database, along with associated child session models for trades and candles. - Added a MonteCarloRunner class to handle the execution of simulations, including validation of parameters and management of CPU resources. - Enhanced logging capabilities specific to Monte Carlo operations, ensuring detailed tracking of simulation progress and errors. - Updated transformers to format Monte Carlo session data for API responses, improving the user experience when interacting with the simulation endpoints. - Integrated error handling and validation to ensure robust operation of the Monte Carlo features, including checks for Python version compatibility. Add help search endpoint to system controller and define HelpSearchRequestJson model - Introduced a new POST endpoint `/help-search` in the system controller to facilitate help center searches while avoiding CORS issues. - Added HelpSearchRequestJson model to handle the request structure for help searches. - Implemented logic to validate authorization tokens and manage requests to the help center API, including error handling for failed requests.
